name: Quarterly Business Review
description: Executive QBR template for performance review, strategic alignment, risks, and account or business planning.

sections.title: Review Scope
sections.instruction: Quarter, business unit or account, participants, facilitator, and review objective

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a concise summary of performance, strategic themes, key risks, and major decisions

sections.title: Performance Metrics
sections.instruction: Capture KPIs, targets, actuals, trend, and commentary discussed during the review

sections.title: Highlights & Wins
sections.instruction: List major successes, milestones, customer outcomes, launches, or operational improvements

sections.title: Risks, Issues & Dependencies
sections.instruction: Summarize risks, active issues, dependencies, escalations, and mitigation owners

sections.title: Strategic Decisions
sections.instruction: Capture decisions about investment, priorities, resourcing, account strategy, or operating model changes

sections.title: Next Quarter Plan
sections.instruction: List priorities, initiatives, owners, success metrics, and expected dates for the next quarter
